moves.name: Headbutt
moves.notes: Always used at the start of combat. Bowlbug Rock starts with Imbalanced . If it is off balance after "Headbutt", the next move is "Dizzy"; otherwise it keeps using "Headbutt".

moves.name: Dizzy
moves.notes: Always followed by Headbutt. Only triggers if it is still off balance after the previous "Headbutt". This move clears off balance and returns to "Headbutt".
